SPY.text: SPY rose about 1.8%, reaching a record close as strong AI-linked earnings and chip gains lifted technology while optimism that a U.S.-Iran deal was near pushed oil and Treasury yields lower.

QQQ.text: QQQ jumped about 3.4%, outpacing the broader market as a 6.6% semiconductor rally and Palantir’s strong results reinforced AI enthusiasm; lower oil and Treasury yields added a broad risk-on tailwind.
